findings.detail: This criterion requires evidence that lives outside the codebase (CI/make run results). The ticket comment attests that 'make lint (incl. complexity ratchet), make typecheck, and the affected test files (spawn_detached, detached_child_cwd, compact_trigger, enrich_drain, enrich_queue, push_strict/parent_exit/child_env: 232 tests) all green. Proceeding to Gerrit.' However, the attestation names specific test files and a count but provides no verifiable specific — no CI build URL/id, no Gerrit change URL, and no timestamp. The concrete-attestation bar for a non-codebase criterion requires at least one verifiable specific (a reference id/URL, a named actor with a measured outcome, or a timestamp). The comment as written is not visible in the ticket snapshot I read as meeting that bar.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment naming the specific CI build URL or Gerrit change URL (e.g. the Gerrit change id or a CI run link), the observed outcome (all green / pass count), and the date/time of the run. This gives the verifiable specific the non-codebase criterion requires.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
